thread:
alex: Quick accessibility pass on the new keyboard shortcuts modal. Noticed a couple of regressions: focus isn't restored to the opener on close, and the modal title isn't announced as an accessible name (VoiceOver just says 'dialog'). Screenshot: https://redwood.dev/snip/shortcuts-modal.png

toni: Thanks. Steps to repro?

alex: Open shortcuts (?), press Esc to close, focus stays on document body instead of the shortcuts button. Also VoiceOver reads 'Dialog' but not 'Keyboard shortcuts' because aria-labelledby is missing.

reece: Proposed fixes: add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="shortcuts-title" and on close restore focus to the trigger. Also trap focus and add sentinel nodes.

aria-bot: automated-scan: flagged missing aria-labelledby, focus restore missing, and live region missing for shortcut changes. Contrast OK.

toni: Also small keyboard nit: when navigating the list with arrow keys we currently use custom key handlers but didn't set tabindex on items. Set tabindex=-1 for each item and manage roving tabindex. Keep items semantic list elements.

alex: Copy tweak: change 'Toggle all' to 'Enable all shortcuts' for clearer SR phrasing.

reece: I'll open a PR "shortcuts-modal: restore focus, aria-labelledby, roving tab" and include unit tests that assert focus returns to trigger and aria-labelledby exists.

toni: I'll run NVDA/VoiceOver checks when PR is up. Thanks team."
